body: Forward test of the base rate method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.58 (naive base rate 0.50) that: IOL Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals FY27 consolidated operating margin is ≥14.0%. Evidence: Q2 FY27 call (2-Nov-2026): Q2 revenue ₹795 cr (+~40% YoY), EBITDA ~₹115 cr, margin 14.4%; H1 revenue ₹1,551 cr (+39%), EBITDA ₹227 cr, margin 14.5%. Mgmt: FY27 '25% plus revenue growth with 14% to 15% of EBITDA'; 'Q3 and Q4… perhaps we should have the same performance'; ethyl acetate/acetic anhydride at full utilisation with better prices; other expenses up on power/fuel and freight (hopes to pass on). Screener OPM: Dec-25 10%, Mar-26 15%, Jun-26 14%, Sep-26 14%. Ibuprofen expansion FY28. Reasoning: Commodity-chemical margins mean-revert; the recent step-up from ~10% to ~14–15% came with favourable spreads (cycle-dependent). H1 at 14.5% means H2 only needs ~13.5%, so modestly above a coin-flip. Resolution: YES if FY27 consolidated Operating Profit ÷ Sales on screener.in's annual P&L ≥14.0% (if screener is unavailable, EBITDA excl. other income ÷ revenue from operations from the Q4 FY27 results). Source: screener.in IOLCP annual P&L; IOLCP Q4 FY27 results. Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: For a commodity-linked small cap whose margin just jumped ~4 pts, the chance it holds within ~0.5 pt for the full year is roughly half.
